findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - GitHub fails to start the review workflow for a pull request.
Done when: When the review check fails to start on GitHub, close stops at once, says the review check failed to start on GitHub, and gives a step that starts it again (a new commit or reopening the pull request) instead of forge close.
The new call uses `own_runs`, which filters workflow runs by the PR head SHA at `src/forge/checks.py:205–210`. GitHub can record a `pull_request_target` run against the base SHA, so that filter misses the failed run and close continues to the existing wait and retry message. [GitHub's checkout implementation](https://github.com/actions/checkout/blob/f9e715a95fcd1f9253f77dd28f11e88d2d6460c7/src/unsafe-pr-checkout-helper.ts) documents this distinction. Separately, `_pending` at `src/forge/checks.py:327–336` refuses on a red test check before the new detection runs, so a simultaneous test failure also hides the startup failure.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - GitHub fails to start the review workflow.
The fake returns its workflow run for any matching command prefix (`tests/conftest.py:341–345`), regardless of the requested SHA, so this test passes when the real API lookup cannot find the run. The shared fixture also sets `FORGE_CHECKS_WAIT=0` (`tests/test_close.py:272`), so the one-request assertion passes even if the diagnosis is delayed until the ordinary wait expires. The test therefore does not prove the real lookup or the promised immediate stop.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 1
Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - a coordinator or worker recovers a review check that failed to start.
The change introduces a new recovery step, but neither `src/forge/templates/skill.md` nor `src/forge/templates/brief.md` is updated. The shipped skill still tells agents to retry close after a check name is missing (`src/forge/templates/skill.md:1412–1413`). The repository's review rule requires a template or brief update when the flow changes.

why: When GitHub fails to start the pull request's review check, forge close keeps saying the review check has not reported and gives forge close again as the next step, so the same wait repeats and nothing starts the check.
